summary.headline: Lunar, Astronomical, and Zodiacal Chapters
summary.text: Catalogue continuation of a Neapolitan codex describing lunar phases, lunar foundation and timing, solar zodiac position, nineteen-year lunar cycles and epacts, Saint Maximus’s indiction method, Easter and computational tables, Heron’s geometry, mathematical and bloodletting observations, prayers and exorcistic formulas, Photius’s epistles, and a zodiac-sign treatise for men and women from Aries to Pisces.
